title: Looks finished. Let us check.
text: You built an app with AI. It looks good. But does it actually work?

title: Start here
text: That's where Praxis comes in. Open the website and choose Test Your Project.

title: Try a private check
text: Pick your project folder. The browser reads the code on your device, points out possible problems, and gives you a prompt to copy. It hasn't run the app yet.

title: Run the local tool
text: For real tests and AI review, run Praxis locally. Here, we're using the working release candidate. The new public package hasn't been released yet.

title: Choose your project
text: Choose a folder, upload your source, or paste a GitHub link. Add your goal and a spending limit. Tests run in a separate Docker copy, after you allow them.

title: Meet the review team
text: Four AI specialists look at the same project: how it feels to use, how reliable it is, how secure it is, and what's needed to ship it.

title: Honest about limits
text: They compare findings and check each other's evidence. If a provider runs out of credit or hits a limit, Praxis tells you. It never pretends the review finished.

title: People join the review
text: People can join the conversation too. Leave a goal, ask a specialist, or add a private note. You decide what the AI team can see.

title: Catch the false success
text: Now watch this. One version saves an order, and its tests pass. The broken version says success, but saves nothing. The real test catches it.

title: Understand the problem
text: Each finding explains the problem, why it matters, and where to look. Checks that didn't run stay visible, so a green result doesn't hide missing work.

title: Make a plan first
text: Next, draft a fix plan. Review the changes, the risks, and the tests. Then copy the plan into your coding agent. Planning leaves your original files untouched.

title: See what happened
text: The source map shows how files connect. The activity view shows what actually ran. You can inspect both instead of trusting a summary.

title: PRAXIS
text: Build with AI. Check with Praxis. Try the browser check first, then go local for the deeper review.
